info.description: Read-only device metadata JSON: {deviceName, fwVersion, protoVersion}.

library.description: Read-only library listing JSON array: [{hash, title, author, words, progressWords, category}].

active.description: R/W currently-selected book hash (8-char hex, FNV-1a of SD path).

transfer.description: Chunked book upload (write + notify). Header frame JSON: {filename, category: 'book'|'article', sizeBytes}. ACK/NACK framing mirrors single-book transfer.

settings.description: R/W rsvpnano settings JSON (reading/display/typography nesting; see apps/rsvpnano CompanionSyncManager.cpp settingsJson).

storage.description: Read-only storage info JSON: {freeBytes, totalBytes, bookCount}.

transfer.chunk_size_note: Max raw bytes per chunk. Sent as raw GATT writes (no base64). Limit = 512 MTU - 3 ATT overhead.
